newsitem.title: QATAR: EU to support membership for all GCC states in WTO.
newsitem.headline: EU to support membership for all GCC states in WTO.

text.p: European Union officials meeting Gulf Arab delegates in Doha on Monday pledged to sponsor the applications of Saudi Arabia and Oman for membership in the World Trade Organisation.

"The EU side reaffirmed its whole-hearted support for the accession to the WTO of all GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) countries which are not already members," a joint communique issued after the seventh meeting of the EU-GCC Ministeral Meeting and Joint Council said.

Four of the six GCC states -- Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates -- are already WTO members. But Saudi Arabia and Oman, which had applied for membership last year, have not yet been admitted.

Qatar's Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al- Thani, who chaired the council meeting, told reporters: "The membership of these two states will have a positive impact on the multilateral trade system and will reinforce the role of the GCC as a regional bloc."
"We look forward to the EU working to support and accelerate the membership of both the kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the sultanate of Oman in this international organisation," Sheikh Hamad said.
